title: 3.4 Function Notation

icans: I can evaluate functions using function notation.
I can find the input that gives a certain output.
I can graph linear functions and interpret function notation in real life.

vocab: f(x), read “f of x,” is the __________ of function f for the input x
the point (a, b) is on the __________ of f
